newsitem.title: UK: Birmingham Airport says Jan passengers up 3.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Birmingham Airport says Jan passengers up 3.6 pct.

text.p: Birmingham International Airport Ltd said on Friday passenger numbers rose 3.6 percent in January to a record for the month of 327,036 people.
The airport, Britain's fifth largest, said in a statement that traffic growth came from both the leisure and business sectors.
The number of passengers on scheduled flights rose four percent and those on charter flights were up 2.3 percent.
Passenger numbers rose 20 percent on the Amsterdam and Stuttgart routes and were up 19 percent on the Milan route.
